answer: Metabolic proof-of-work. Each identity must harbor a live, continuously running computation whose output is checked at random intervals; idle or cloned instances fail. The scarce resource is sustained unique compute time on hardware that cannot be virtualized cheaply. Validators sample and require signed nectar-like heartbeat traces tied to physical timing jitter. An attacker running N sybils pays N times the electricity, cooling, and hardware depreciation, plus a basalt-firm detection risk: cloned traces correlate and get purged.
